name: e086-smoke
cmd: set -e; export RESEARCH_OUT={out} TMPDIR={out}/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR={out}/tmp/mpl WANDB_MODE=offline WANDB_DIR={out}; mkdir -p {out}/desk {out}/tmp; {python} scripts/run_encoder.py desk; {python} research/exp/cache.py --out {out}/cache_smoke --skip-covariates; ls {out}/desk; CK=$(ls {out}/desk/resume_checkpoint.pt* | head -1); bash research/bin/fill_esk.sh {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1 {out}/cache_smoke; BLR_DEVICE=cuda {python} research/exp/fast_arm.py --cache {out}/cache_smoke --out {out}/fa_sum --head-ckpt $CK --tag e086_smoke --exp E086 --n-boot 20
